newsitem.title: USA: Regis, ex-Supercuts chairman settle suits.
newsitem.headline: Regis, ex-Supercuts chairman settle suits.

text.p: Regis Corp said Friday it reached an agreement with David Lipson, former chief executive and chairman of Supercuts Inc, to settle lawsuits and countersuits.
Supercuts is a Regis subsidiary, following an acquisition last October.
The suits followed Lipson's dismissal by the Supercuts board of directors in January 1, 1996.

Lipson will receive a $6.7 million payment under the agreement. In addition, Regis has agreed to provide Lipson with documents, information and other assistance in connection with Lipson's defense in a recent Securities and Exchange Commission action alleging insider trading of Supercuts shares.
Regis said the SEC based its initial investigation of Lipson's trades on allegations made by former Supercuts executives.
Under the agreement, Regis said it will no longer be liable to make advances for Lipson's legal expenses in the SEC matter.
As part of the settlement, each side released the other from future claims.
Regis said the settlement would have no material effect on its net income for the quarter and year ending June 30.
